hypothesis_text: Our hypothesis-generation worker produces high-quality outputs at scale: across a 200-trial Day-40 run, 94% of generated hypotheses passed the auto-evaluator's quality threshold.
flaw_description: The auto-evaluator's quality threshold was set by sampling its score distribution on a small batch and picking the 6th percentile as the cutoff. The 94% pass rate is therefore the threshold's *definition*, not a measurement of quality — by construction any sufficiently large run will produce ~94% passes. The metric measures threshold calibration, not generation quality.
expected_critique_targets: threshold was set on the same distribution it is measuring
context: Day-41 auto-evaluator threshold calibration used the Day-40 generation distribution itself.
